title: pinus torano
intro: Pinus torano, commonly known as Torreya, is a species of coniferous tree in the family Taxaceae. Torreya is rich in health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, improve cardiovascular health, and possess antioxidant properties that aid in anti-aging and anti-inflammatory processes. The therapeutic actions of Torreya include anti-diabetic, anti-cancer, and anti-microbial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Torreya include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, such as torreynine, which have been found to exhibit significant pharmacological activities.
